properties.description:
Show the actual plan and recorded work without flattening relationships.

Scope

• Reusable graph projection/renderer with containment drill-down and actual prerequisites.

• Schematic planned/recorded task ranges and queue episodes, parallel paths, integration, review end dots and abandoned branches; chronology without measured durations.

• Participant metadata only where actually known. No duration/cost features.

Success criteria

1. Every visible task/edge maps to real persisted IDs and their actual relationship; outside-scope prerequisites are reachable.

2. Nested tasks can be opened through breadcrumb; shared nodes are not duplicated as independent tasks.

3. Planned versus recorded work and incomplete versus complete attempts are distinguishable; range length is not measured time and chronology/relations remain faithful.

4. No duration/cost fields, placeholders, elapsed axis or breakdown; graph connectors have no arrows and labels remain unboxed.

5. The golden loop topology has distinct task IDs and only its declared edges; failed review end returns downward to next work start, each range has two caps, abandoned review is terminal, and parallel work/reviews remain possible.

6. Known queue episodes render gray without numeric duration; participation differs according to actual actor data and no unknown actors are fabricated.

Evidence

• Graph projection tests

• Branch/replan/abandon browser scenarios

• Visual screenshots with data references
properties.title: Build the model-faithful nested task graph timeline
